svg.title: Heartbeat viewport interaction ownership fail-closed scar
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing visible heartbeat contact at capture, then two stale-work guards: ambiguous empty heartbeat focus fails closed while the existing owner lacks complete focus-scope evidence, and a newer direct keyboard-focus move supersedes a persistent selection-anchored viewport ticket. Explicit policy can later grant rebuild amnesty only with mutation-class and overlay-wide focus-scope facts. Android runtime behavior and TalkBack accessibility focus remain unproven.
svg.text: WARM WALL / PERSISTENT SELECTION ≠ PERMANENT OWNER
INTERACTION POLICY YES • LEGACY EMPTY FOCUS FAIL-CLOSED • OWNER SCOPE WIRING NO • TALKBACK UNCLAIMED
Capture both semantic anchor and keyboard-focus baseline.
selection persists; newer keyboard navigation cancels A ticket
Legacy caller + empty heartbeat focus → ◇ HOLD WALL / NO RESTORE. Missing scope is not rebuild evidence.
Explicit overload + rebuild destroyed captured focus + no direct overlay focus → restore may be allowed.
Explicit overload + newer heartbeat or non-heartbeat direct focus → stale ticket dies, even if selection persists.
CAPTURE BASELINE + MUTATION CLASS + FOCUS SCOPE
No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Direct keyboard focus truth ≠ TalkBack accessibility focus. Safe refusal ≠ runtime proof.
No phone surface consumed. No second renderer. Next seam: existing owner supplies actual mutation class + overlay-wide direct-focus presence.
